_comment: KNOWN RED browser specs (TC-2120). The Web browser tests job fails only on a failure that is NOT listed here; listed tests are printed as known reds. When a spec is fixed, delete its entry (the job prints 'known red now passes: delete it from the list'); when the list is empty, delete this file and the knownReds argument of the summary step. Each entry needs a ruling or a diagnosis, not a skip.

knownReds.title: v2 displays original and exact preview, signs the bound context, and pastes an unchanged S3 result
